# hiok_analytics_cluster (Resource)

A managed columnar analytics cluster for event, log and time-series data.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password (default: generated).
- `admin_username` (String)
- `database_name` (String)
- `engine_version` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `sku` (String) dev (1 vCPU / 2 GiB), small (2/8), medium (4/16) or large (8/32).
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `vnet_address` (String) Address to take on that network, in CIDR form, e.g. 10.0.0.20/24.
- `vnet_name` (String) Virtual network to join, so machines on it reach the cluster privately.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String)
- `http_endpoint` (String)
- `http_port` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `native_port` (Number)
- `ram_gb` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `v_cpu` (Number)
- `vnet_attached` (Boolean)
